conflicts.description: Helmfile spec manages K8s deployments but does not address secret management. devbob-k8s-git-operations spec requires valid GITHUB_TOKEN in devbob-secrets but helmfile.yaml does not include Secret resources or reference external secret management.
conflicts.currentBehavior: helmfile.yaml only manages Deployments, Services, StatefulSets. Secrets are managed out-of-band via kubectl commands.
conflicts.desiredBehavior: Secrets should be managed via Helm/helmfile (sealed-secrets, external-secrets, or helm secrets plugin) to comply with 'helmfile-only' deployment pattern.
conflicts.impact: Violates helmfile-only principle. Secrets require direct kubectl commands, creating a deployment antipattern.

resolution.option1: Integrate sealed-secrets controller and manage encrypted secrets via helmfile
resolution.option2: Use external-secrets operator to sync secrets from external vault
resolution.option3: Document exception: secrets managed separately for security (acceptable if documented)
resolution.recommended: Option 3 (document exception) - Secret management via kubectl is standard Kubernetes practice for security. Update specification to explicitly allow secret management as documented exception to helmfile-only rule.

conflicts.spec2: Instance-Invariant Storage - Missing Backend API Endpoints
conflicts.description: Validation detected configuration drift (running 0.12.5, configured 0.12.6). Root cause: Instance-Invariant Storage spec added backend API endpoints requiring code changes to metabob-rpc-api, but deployment was not synced after enforcement.
conflicts.currentBehavior: Code changes deployed to repos/ directory, but Kubernetes deployment not updated. Running old version.
conflicts.desiredBehavior: After enforcement phase adds/modifies backend code, deployment should be automatically synced via helmfile.
conflicts.impact: Running deployment does not include enforced changes from other specifications. Backend may lack required API endpoints.

resolution.immediate: Run 'helmfile sync' to update deployment to 0.12.6
resolution.longTerm: Add post-enforcement hook to automatically run helmfile sync after code changes
resolution.automation: Integrate with CI/CD to deploy on code changes

conflicts.description: Enforcement phase created production-specific values files (devbob.production.values.yaml, metabob-rpc-api.production.values.yaml) but did not update helmfile.yaml to load these files when environment=production. Validation failed: production template does not render Istio resources.
conflicts.currentBehavior: Production values files exist but are not referenced by helmfile.yaml releases. Istio remains disabled in production templates.
conflicts.desiredBehavior: helmfile.yaml should conditionally load production values files based on environment variable.
conflicts.impact: Production deployments will not have Istio service mesh integration despite enforcement creating all necessary templates and configuration.

resolution.fix: Update helm/helmfile.yaml to conditionally load production values
resolution.validation: Re-run validation harness to verify Istio resources render in production template
